Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week — the hosted API latency and the batching controls look very promising for our genAI features. We're evaluating multi-year prepay options to get better unit economics while keeping the ability to true-up annually.

High level on our side: SlatePoint is forecasting ~12B input tokens (large-context embeddings + chat) in Year 1, rising to ~26B in Year 2 if adoption goes as planned. We're open to an annualized prepay (pay up front for Year 1 + Year 2 with a scheduled ramp) or a 24–36 month prepaid commitment.

Can you share your typical discount bands for a 2-year prepaid (annualized), suggested ramp breakpoints, and how true-up will be handled? Also need any sample SOW / billing schedule we can share with procurement.

We'll loop Alyssa (procurement) on the thread.

Evan — great to hear and thanks for the detail. TL;DR: we can support an annualized 2-yr prepay with a volume-tier discount + staged ramp and an annual true-up. I'll summarize below and follow up with a spreadsheet and SOW draft.

Proposed structure (initial):
- Term: 24 months, prepaid annually (customer pays Year 1 and Year 2 at signature)
- Discount: 15–20% off list, scale based on committed annual token volume
- Ramp: front-loaded usage expectation Year 1 (50–60% of Year 1 forecast in first 6 months), with contractual ramp breakpoints at month 6 and month 12 to allow mid-term adjustment
- True-up: annual true-up at each anniversary (outstanding usage billed at list less committed discount tiers; unused prepay rolls forward as credit)

Next steps I need from you: a target committed tokens/year per year (we can anchor using your 12B / 26B projection), preferred start date, and any procurement constraints (PO timing, net terms). I attached a sample pricing model and a draft SOW we use for prepaids.

Can we aim for a 30-minute call early next week to lock specifics?

Hi Evan / Alyssa — thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. Below is the formal offer and proposed next steps. Quoted in plain language so you can circulate to procurement.

Offer summary
- Term: 24 months (Apr 15, 2027 start)
- Payment: Prepaid at signature for Year 1 + Year 2 (single invoice / wire).
- Committed annualized volumes: Year 1 = 12B tokens, Year 2 = 26B tokens (per your forecast).
- Pricing: List $0.0009/token; Committed discount: 17% applied to the annualized prepaid amount.
- Effective prepaid amounts: Year 1: $8,964,000; Year 2: $19,422,000; Total prepaid: $28,386,000.

Ramp & true-up mechanics
- Ramp checkpoints: M6 and M12 from start date. If actual cumulative usage at M6 < 80% of M6 expected, we offer one-time rebaseline to protect SlatePoint (documentation requirement: usage reports).
- True-up: Annual true-up at each anniversary comparing committed vs actual usage. Any overage to be invoiced at list minus committed discount bands; any unused prepaid credit will roll forward for 12 months as account credit.

SLA & legal
- SLA credits capped at 0.5% of annual prepaid per quarter for availability SLO misses.
- Model substitution: Redwood will provide compatibility-equivalent model or proportional credit; details in attached clause.
